verdict.rationale: Goodwin's own IP Litigation page describes a dedicated team of over 80 litigators and lead-counsel work in hundreds of Patent Trial and Appeal Board matters, which names a venue. Its trademark and trade-secret pages confirm trademark litigation and a trade secrets practice. However, the evidence names no courts and describes no case outcomes, and the trademark and trade-secret litigation claims carry no venue detail. Missing for 10: named courts or case outcomes on the firm's pages, venue or outcome detail for the trademark and trade-secret disputes, and independent corroboration of the litigation record.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm litigates IP disputes — patent, trademark, or trade-secret — with courts, venues, or outcomes described on its own pages

citations.quote: We have served as lead counsel in hundreds of Patent Trial and Appeal Board matters.
In addition to trademark litigation, our practice also focuses on portfolio development and enforcement.
We have one of the most comprehensive trade secrets and employee mobility practices in the nation.
